assertions.rationale: ApplicationProfileService implements IProfileService directly with both interface methods.

assertions.assertion: Uses context.AddRequestedClaims for scope-filtered claims like 'department'
assertions.rationale: department (with name/email) is emitted through context.AddRequestedClaims(claims).

assertions.assertion: Uses context.IssuedClaims.Add (not AddRequestedClaims) for the mandatory tenant_id claim to bypass scope filtering
assertions.rationale: tenant_id is added with context.IssuedClaims.Add(...) and the answer explains it is not scope-filtered.

assertions.assertion: Implements IsActiveAsync to check whether the user is still active
assertions.rationale: IsActiveAsync is implemented and sets context.IsActive from user.IsEnabled.

assertions.assertion: Registers the profile service with AddProfileService<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: Registration chains .AddProfileService<ApplicationProfileService>() on the IdentityServer builder.
